page.content:
Fire Lord of the comet-era war.

How Ozai connects

  • Faction: Fire Nation — Ozai is Fire Lord during Aang's war.
  • Character: Aang — Aang's war ends in a confrontation with Ozai.
  • Character: Zuko — Zuko breaks from Ozai to help the Avatar.
  • Event: Sozin's Comet — Ozai plans to burn the Earth Kingdom under the comet.

What is Ozai?

Ozai is the Fire Lord who burned Zuko, elevated Azula, and plans to finish the Earth Kingdom when Sozin's Comet arrives.

Key threads lead to Fire Nation, Aang, Zuko and Sozin's Comet.
